verdict.rationale: Recurly documents rich plan-change mechanics for upgrades, downgrades, quantity and add-on changes with proration control, and Recurly Engage offers a configurable Cancel/Save flow shown to subscribers during cancellation. None of the evidence shows a hosted customer portal or embeddable components that let customers make these changes themselves. Missing for 10: an evidenced hosted self-service account portal, embeddable upgrade/downgrade/cancel components, documentation that customers can initiate plan changes without merchant action, and independent corroboration.
